# Prof. Dr. S. Balaji Science Academy

> Board-exam focused Physics and Chemistry coaching for Class 12 (CBSE and TN State Board) and free CBSE Class 10 Science lessons, taught by Prof. Dr. S. Balaji. Classroom sessions in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu, live online classes on Google Meet, and hybrid learning. The website also offers free study resources and a login-based practice and mock test platform.

Website: https://profbalaji.in/
Location: No. 26, Avvai Street, Athiyaman Nagar, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu 631 501, India
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97876 92116
Email: contact@profbalaji.in

## About the teacher

- Prof. Dr. S. Balaji holds a PhD in Physical Chemistry from the University of Madras (1999), with postdoctoral fellowships at IIT Madras and Sunchon National University, South Korea, and a visiting scientist term at JNCASR, Bengaluru.
- More than 25 years of teaching experience and over 50 international publications.
- Teaching approach: concept-first, with regular practice tests, doubt clearing and small batches.
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.co.kr/citations?hl=en&pli=1&user=9NAUZ5MAAAAJ
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/profdrsbalaji

## Courses

- [CBSE Class 12 Physics & Chemistry](https://profbalaji.in/pages/courses/cbse12.html): full NCERT syllabus, concept-first teaching, regular tests and full-length exams until the board exams. Weekday batch Mon to Sat 5:30 AM to 6:30 AM; weekend batch Sat 6:00 PM to 8:30 PM and Sun 6:00 AM to 8:30 AM.
- [TN State Board Class 12 Physics & Chemistry](https://profbalaji.in/pages/courses/stateboard12.html): full syllabus with the same teaching approach. Weekday batch Mon to Sat 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM.
- [CBSE Class 10 Science (free)](https://profbalaji.in/pages/courses/cbse10.html): complete syllabus lectures, solved previous year papers, one-shot revision videos and chapter-wise notes, free on the CBSE Digest YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@CBSEdigest).

## Ways to attend

- Classroom in Kanchipuram, live online classes via Google Meet (open to students anywhere), or hybrid. A free demo class is offered; contact the academy by call or WhatsApp. Fee details are shared personally on request.

## Practice and mock tests

- [Chapter-wise Practice & Mock Tests](https://profbalaji.in/pages/test.html): questions written by Prof. Dr. S. Balaji, organised by board, class, subject and chapter, for CBSE Class 10 Science, CBSE Class 12 and TN State Board Class 12 Physics and Chemistry. Access is ₹1,000 per academic year and ₹0 for students of the classroom and online course. Sign-in is with a Google account and access is activated by the academy.

## Free learning resources

- [Study Planner](https://profbalaji.in/pages/studyplanner/): create a personalised preparation schedule and download it as a PDF.
- [Interactive Periodic Table](https://profbalaji.in/pages/periodictable/): all 118 elements with properties, isotopes and uses.
- [Chapter Mind Maps](https://profbalaji.in/pages/mindmap/): chapter-wise mind maps for CBSE and State Board syllabus.
- [Class 12 Physics Formula Sheet](https://profbalaji.in/pages/physicsformulas/): chapter-wise formulas, variables and constants.
- [Class 12 Chemistry Equations Bank](https://profbalaji.in/pages/chemistryequations/): chapter-wise chemical equations with notes.
- [Log Book](https://profbalaji.in/pages/logbook/): logarithm, antilogarithm and trigonometric tables.
